title: Household-Size Schedule for Pre-K Tuition Payment Plans
content:
**Schedule.** Under the household-size schedule of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, a Pre-K tuition payment plan is spread over more installments for a household with several children holding a School Nutrition Services Meal Account in status active:

| Children of the household holding a School Nutrition Services meal account in status active | Additional installments |
|---|---|
| three or more | 2 more |
| exactly two | 1 more |
| one or none | none |

Every active meal account of the household counts, whatever its tier; an inactive account does not.

## Examples (hypothetical households)

- Three children with active meal accounts: 2 more installments.
- Two children with active meal accounts and a third whose account is inactive: 1 more installment.
- One child with an active meal account: no additional installment.
